reason_code.comparison: Exact original Unicode code-point sequence against raw_requirement.reason_code; no trimming, Unicode normalization, case folding, prefix match or substitution.

permitted_write_namespaces.json_evidence_encoding: Only after native type checks, encode actual tuple elements as an ordered JSON array and retain the original built-in tuple type in the same provenance record. comparison_sequence: Validate the fixed source/type binding and the actual per-variant return provenance; no expected-to-observed copying.

Encode only type-valid observations losslessly for evidence display, retaining type/member/tuple provenance and any value mismatch. Encoding is separate from and cannot override the native comparison.

gate_decision_output.mismatch_policy: No PASS from projection alone. On missing observation, type failure or value mismatch, preserve available raw provenance and the failure/exception without repair; stop the affected comparison. sequence: Verify fixed source, exact input variant and actual return provenance.
